verdict.rationale: Parallel task attempts with side-by-side comparison is a fair capability to ask of a coding agent, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented feature for running several attempts of a task in parallel and choosing among them. Non-interactive scripting (gh-6) and conversation checkpointing (gh-8) are adjacent features or user-side workarounds, and the community mention of a 'subagent system' (comm-9) does not describe parallel attempts or comparing results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one
